pages.title: Speaker peripheral
pages.text: With CC:Tweaked, main speakers expose the simply_speaker peripheral.$(br2)Optional support covers 1.20.1 and 1.21.1.$(br2)Anonymous computer control requires Public access.

pages.title: Playback methods
pages.text: play, pause, togglePause, stop, restart, next, previous, seek and setTrack control transport.$(br2)Local audio must belong to the network owner; remote streams require server permission.

pages.title: State and settings
pages.text: getLibrary lists owner recordings. getSavedPlaylists lists saved templates; playSavedPlaylist loads a playback copy. getPlaylist and getQueue inspect the speaker.$(br2)Queue and playlist slots start at 1.

pages.title: Playback settings
pages.text: setVolume and setAudioDropoff use 0–1; setRange uses blocks. setRepeatMode accepts none, track or playlist. setShuffle toggles shuffle. setLooping is a compatibility alias for track Repeat.

pages.title: Queue and access
pages.text: queueNext and queueLast add requests. removeQueued, moveQueued and clearQueue edit them.$(br2)Calls return false when denied.$(br2)Computers cannot manage claimed networks or edit personal playlist templates.

pages.title: Playback events
pages.text: Events report started, paused, resumed, stopped, track changed and finished.$(br2)Arguments are attachment name, audio ID and network name.$(br2)See the technical reference for method signatures.
